classes/force-missile-mage-986.proficiencyText: Force missile mages gain no new weapon or armor proficiencies.

classes/master-of-the-yuirwood-886.name: Master of the Yuirwood
classes/master-of-the-yuirwood-886.proficiencyText: Masters of the Yuirwood are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, and shields.

prerequisites.label: Special
prerequisites.text: Must qualify to select regional feats from Aglarond or the star elf region; the region is the character's home region or the character has 2 ranks in Knowledge (local—Aglarond or star elf).

reviewEvidence.note: Exact Unapproachable East D&D 3.0 record reviewed, including regional eligibility, training, all ten levels of casting advancement, menhir use scaling and SLAs.
